items.name: Anthropic Claude API
items.authentication: Anthropic API key passed as Authorization Bearer header; key stored in secured environment variable per ASSUMPTION-002.
items.errorHandling: Fail-closed: on timeout or 5xx response, return HTTP 503 to caller; session state preserved; WARN log entry written. On 429 rate limit, propagate Retry-After to caller.

sla.latency: First streaming token target < 5 seconds; full response target < 30 seconds
sla.throughput: 50 requests per tenant per hour (BR-003 cap)
sla.availability: Not SLA-bound; Anthropic API availability is outside GoA control

items.capabilityJustification: Commercial LLM inference API; no matching capability in GoA enterprise service catalog taxonomy.
items.stubRationale: Anthropic API contract, key provisioning, and GoA information management policy approval (OPEN-001, OPEN-002, OPEN-006) must be resolved before live integration is enabled.

items.name: ADSP Configuration Service
items.authentication: ADSP service-to-service JWT issued by initializePlatform() SDK; token refreshed automatically by the ADSP SDK.
items.errorHandling: On read failure, return empty pattern list (lookup-empty). On write failure, return HTTP 503 and discard the write; no partial config state.

sla.throughput: Unlimited; ADSP Config Service is shared platform infrastructure
sla.availability: ADSP platform SLA applies; treated as highly available

items.capabilityJustification: ADSP internal platform service; not listed in enterprise service catalog taxonomy.
items.stubRationale: ADSP Configuration Service availability in target tenant environments is unconfirmed (OPEN-004); live integration requires ADSP platform provisioning and SDK initialization.

items.name: ADSP Event Service (RabbitMQ)
items.authentication: ADSP service-to-service JWT issued by initializePlatform() SDK; event types registered at startup.
items.errorHandling: Fail-closed on RabbitMQ unavailability: session operation completes but event publish is logged as WARN and discarded; no rollback of session state.

sla.throughput: One event per triggering action (session lifecycle events and hypothesis generation)
sla.availability: ADSP platform SLA applies; event service treated as eventually available

items.capabilityJustification: ADSP internal platform event service; not listed in enterprise service catalog taxonomy.
items.stubRationale: ADSP RabbitMQ event service requires live ADSP platform provisioning and event type registration via initializePlatform() SDK; not available in standalone development environments.

items.name: Keycloak JWT Authorization Server
items.authentication: Keycloak realm public key used by passport-jwt to validate RS256 JWT signature; public key fetched from Keycloak JWKS endpoint at startup.
items.errorHandling: Fail-closed: any JWT validation failure (expired, tampered, missing) returns HTTP 401; no session data is accessible until a valid JWT is presented.

sla.latency: < 10ms for local JWT validation (no remote call per request; public key cached)
sla.throughput: Unlimited; JWT validation is stateless and CPU-bound
sla.availability: ADSP platform Keycloak SLA applies; service degrades to full 401 if Keycloak JWKS endpoint is unreachable and cached key is expired

items.capabilityJustification: ADSP internal Keycloak identity provider; not listed in enterprise service catalog taxonomy.
items.stubRationale: ADSP Keycloak realm requires client registration and role configuration (ASSUMPTION-001); live integration requires provisioned ADSP tenant environment.
